text: Folks, this is your captain. We are currently third in line for takeoff, which is also how I rank my marriages.
We have a slight delay on the runway. The runway is my twenties. The tower has questions about my flight plan, and frankly so does Brenda.
Your baggage may have shifted during the relationship. Please check the overhead compartment, where I keep my apologies.
The fasten-seatbelt sign is on. It has been on since 2019. Brenda says I use it to avoid conversations, and Brenda is extremely correct.
We know you have choices in airlines, and even more choices in husbands. Thank you for choosing poorly, again.
We will be landing shortly in Denver, emotionally speaking. Please remain seated until I have fully stopped caring. Thank you.
